stemMarkdown: In a 100 m race, A finishes in 50 seconds and B finishes in 54 seconds. By how many metres does A beat B? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: B's speed is $\dfrac{100}{54} = 1.8519$ m/s. When A finishes at 50 s, B has covered $1.8519 \times 50 = 92.5926$ m. A therefore beats B by $7.4074$ m.
